name: quantified-self-sheets-ts
description: TypeScript port of the Apps Script sync jobs. Platform-agnostic core, one adapter per runtime.

scripts.stage:sync: node scripts/prepare-legacy.mjs sync && npm run build
scripts.push:sync: npm run stage:sync && clasp -P .clasp-sync.json push && npm run verify:sync
scripts.push:log: npm run stage:log && clasp -P .clasp-log.json push && npm run verify:log
